notes.title: 🔥 Release Date Revealed: A Game About Digging a Hole launches on ... 🔥
notes.notes:
It’s time – grab your shovels! We’re excited to announce the official release date for [b][i]A Game About Digging a Hole[/i][/b]: February 7, 2025.

In the latest trailer, we’re also showcasing the Jetpack in action for the very first time! 🚀
[previewyoutube=4pCvvyzFlXA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What’s new?[/h3]
We’ve made several improvements as we prepared for the release:
[list]
[*] Fixed bugs to ensure everything runs smoothly.
[*] Added more languages so an even wider audience can enjoy the adventure.
[/list]

[h3]Add it to your wishlist![/h3]
Get ready to uncover treasures and secrets! Add [b][i]A Game About Digging a Hole[/i][/b] to your wishlist now so you won’t miss the launch:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3244220/A_Game_About_Digging_A_Hole/

[h3]Help us go viral![/h3]
Our community gave us amazing support with our first post – and we’re counting on you again! Share our latest tweet, comment, or like it to help as many people as possible hear about the game:
👉 https://x.com/HoleDiggingGame/status/1881708558942965791


Your support makes all the difference. Thank you for being part of this adventure!
